## Dexcom Announces Upcoming Conference Presentation


November 24, 2026


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[DexCom, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dexcom.com%2F&esheet=54645781&newsitemid=20261124441248&lan=en-US&anchor=DexCom%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=a97607d10e158056c50d7888477a747d) (NASDAQ:DXCM) today announced that management will present an update on the company at the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, December 1, 2026.


The live presentation is scheduled to begin at approximately 9:00 AM EST and will be concurrently webcast.


Links to the webcast will be available on the Dexcom Investor Relations website at[investors.dexcom.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.dexcom.com%2F&esheet=54645781&newsitemid=20261124441248&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.dexcom.com&index=2&md5=1315cd7231be8a5444a1c5bd64c16e77) and will be archived there for future reference.


**About DexCom, Inc.**


Dexcom empowers people to take control of health through innovative biosensing technology. Founded in 1999, Dexcom has pioneered and set the standard in glucose biosensing for more than 25 years. Its technology has transformed how people manage diabetes and track their glucose, helping them feel more in control and live more confidently.


Dexcom. Discover what you’re made of. For more information, visit[www.dexcom.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.dexcom.com&esheet=54645781&newsitemid=20261124441248&lan=en-US&anchor=www.dexcom.com&index=3&md5=343d7d7928648fa0f3fde38f8e0b0baa) .
